style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about prehistoric animals of South America. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no scenery.

items.ground-sloth: A single Giant Ground Sloth Megatherium standing up on its hind legs facing right seen from the side, a huge shaggy brown bear-like body leaning on its thick tail, long arms with big curved claws reaching up, a small friendly head
items.glyptodon: A single Glyptodon standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a giant armadillo relative with a big round domed shell made of many small hexagonal plates like a turtle, a small armoured cap on its head, a thick armoured tail with rings, short sturdy legs, tan and brown colours
items.macrauchenia: A single Macrauchenia standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a camel-like animal with a long neck, long thin legs and a short floppy trunk on its nose, sandy brown fur
items.toxodon: A single Toxodon standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a big heavy rhino-like animal without horns, a big broad head with a wide mouth, short thick legs, grey brown skin
items.terror-bird: A single Terror Bird Phorusrhacos standing on two long legs facing right seen from the side, a tall flightless bird with a huge hooked yellow beak, small wings, grey and dark brown feathers
items.short-faced-bear: A single giant South American short-faced bear Arctotherium standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, very long legs, a short round face, thick brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle and cream rings around the eyes
